evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'I think I initially mentioned just the hourly rate... I'll go ahead and just you know, create one for you agency about ten to fifteen minutes just to discuss your move so I can give you a, a personalized estimate, okay?' — framing is present (time-boxed + quote promise) but she rushes past without waiting for an actual affirmative from James before proceeding into probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'And before we proceed, I just wanted to check if you have any important concerns or instructions for this move that you also want to discuss on this call.' James: 'No.' — Asked after she had already begun gathering logistics (name, contact, date, pod sizes), not at the start of discovery.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised no concerns (said 'No' when asked), so this is N/A — no follow-up was required.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised, so this is N/A — no reflection was needed.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (single story home), floor/stories (single story), number of rooms (4 bedrooms), walking distance (short, on driveway/street), furniture content and box count (~100 boxes total), special items (some dishes, 1–2 boxes electronics, no heavy items), additional stops (implied single address). All seven logistics categories addressed.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. Joanna never offered packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Joanna: 'Do you think we'll have about more than fifty boxes in total?' and James responds 'I would probably say a hundred ish.' Box count explicitly discussed.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna: 'Typically a sixteen foot part, usually we'll be able to, you know, unload everything in an, in an hour and a half to two hours since we have two pots in here for now, I'll just put this move for the three to four hour mark, which is an estimated budget of $832. If the guys will just be able to finish everything within the minimum, the minimum cost for the move is, $520.' — Range provided ($520–$832) and personalized to two pods at this address.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna: '$208 per hour... for the two men and the truck... taxes, insurance, credit card fees, fuel transportation fees, basically everything... two and a half hour minimum. If we go over the minimum, we only charge in fifteen minute intervals.' — Fees disclosed upfront (truck inclusive, no extra fees), 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increments framed as commitment.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Joanna never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent, and moved directly into scheduling logistics.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna: 'And lastly on time guarantee if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts by the end of the day again no hidden fees of any type.' — Full delivery of discount terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna: 'We also include other features like our no worries, damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages.' — $2,000 coverage mentioned, but she did not explicitly state 'no deductible,' 'no fine print,' or 'built into the rate (not an add-on)' — partial delivery.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Joanna did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. No explicit close of the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna: 'Alright, thank you so much. Any other questions.' — Generic throwaway 'Any other questions?' not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was posed.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Joanna never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable version of an explicit ask for the business. She moved directly to scheduling and email confirmation.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Joanna: 'If you need to make changes later let's say her to schedule just let us know ahead of time so we can assist you with that as well. The payment is only upon completion of each move' — Rate/booking terms clarified (changes possible pre-move, payment after completion), satisfying the intent of rate-lock / deposit confirmation.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Confirmed: Date (30th September, Wednesday), time (8:30 AM–9:00 AM), address (9408 ama drive), phone (will be in email). Missing: crew size (two-man crew is implied but never explicitly stated as confirmed for this job), detailed notes left with crew about customer concerns (she mentions 'I'll send everything in an email' but no specific notes about their concerns logged for the crew). Partial confirmation.

top_strength: Joanna gathered all critical logistics details systematically and provided a fully anchored, personalized estimate with complete pricing transparency and fee disclosure upfront.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business — this call closed with scheduling and email confirmation but no explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' ask, and Section 6's final concerns check was a generic 'Any other questions?' rather than the genuine concern probe the script requires.
booking_note: Customer confirmed scheduling for September 30th between 8:30-9:00 AM: 'Alright, so I'll put you guys on schedule 30th of September which is a Wednesday between 8:30 AM and 9:00 AM'
